lines.zh: 我回到屋里，发现 Noriko 在柜台后面哭。

lines.en: She wipes her tears away as I approach her before smiling the same obsessive, partly creepy smile she always has when I’m nearby.
lines.zh: 我走近时，她擦掉眼泪，然后露出那种我靠近时她一贯的、痴迷又有点瘆人的笑容。

lines.en: And, in spite of what I think my body wants me to do, I wrap my arms around her and tell her I was just kidding.
lines.zh: 而尽管我的身体想要我做别的事，我还是张开双臂抱住她，告诉她我刚才只是在开玩笑。

lines.en: What a powerful pair of words that can be when used in the right context.
lines.zh: 在恰当的语境下，这两个字的力量有多么强大。

lines.en: We break apart and, minutes later, the time comes for me to go home.
lines.zh: 我们分开，几分钟后，我该回家了。

lines.en: As I make my way to the door, she reminds me of how much she loves me.
lines.zh: 在我朝门口走去时，她提醒我她有多爱我。

lines.en: And I tell her I love her too.
lines.zh: 而我也告诉她，我也爱她。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: else:
I go back inside and spend the next few minutes hanging out with Noriko.
lines.zh: 我回到屋里，接下来的几分钟和 Noriko 待在一起。

lines.en: I neglect to inform her of her roommate's sudden desire to hang out with someone else as I don’t want to negatively impact her self esteem in any way.
lines.zh: 我没有告诉她，她的室友突然想去找别人玩，因为我不想以任何方式打击她的自尊。

lines.en: And as I pat myself on the back for doing yet another good deed, I’m reminded of how truly fulfilling life can be when all goes according to plan.
lines.zh: 而当我为又做了一件好事而自我表扬时，我想起当一切按计划进行时，人生可以有多么充实。

lines.en: Of course, that only happens once in a blue moon.
lines.zh: 当然，那种事千载难逢。

lines.en: So as the next two years approach but never arrive due to time’s incessant desire to cum inside of us and leave us passed out on the bedroom floor-
lines.zh: 所以当接下来的两年逼近却永不抵达——因为时间不懈地渴望射在我们体内，让我们昏倒在卧室地板上——

lines.en: I will try to keep that in mind.
lines.zh: 我会努力记住这一点。

lines.en: And I will fail miserably.
lines.zh: 而我会惨败。

lines.en: The same way I fail at virtually everything else that matters.
lines.zh: 就像我在几乎所有其他重要的事上惨败一样。

lines.en: Or at least that’s what I {i}would{/i} say if anything else mattered to begin with.
lines.zh: 或者至少，如果还有什么别的事是重要的，我{i}会{/i}这么说。

lines.en: Pain is real. It’s all of us that aren’t.
lines.zh: 痛苦是真实的。不真实的反而是我们所有人。
